title: The Eternal Covenant of Peace

questions.question: "Sing, O barren one, who did not bear; break forth into singing and cry aloud, you who have not been in labor! For the children of the desolate one will be more than the children of her who is what?"
questions.explanation: Isaiah 54:1 (ESV): "than the children of her who is married,"

questions.question: Enlarge the place of your tent, and let the curtains of your habitations be stretched out; do not hold back; lengthen your cords and strengthen your what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 54:2 (ESV): "lengthen your cords and strengthen your stakes."

questions.question: Fear not, for you will not be ashamed; be not confounded, for you will not be disgraced; for you will forget the shame of your what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 54:4 (ESV): "forget the shame of your youth,"

questions.question: For your Maker is your husband, the LORD of hosts is his name; and the Holy One of Israel is your what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 54:5 (ESV): "and the Holy One of Israel is your Redeemer,"

questions.question: For the mountains may depart and the hills be removed, but my steadfast love shall not depart from you, and my covenant of peace shall not be what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 54:10 (ESV): "and my covenant of peace shall not be removed,"

questions.question: O afflicted one, storm-tossed and not comforted, behold, I will set your stones in antimony, and lay your foundations with what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 54:11 (ESV): "and lay your foundations with sapphires."

questions.question: All your children shall be taught by the LORD, and great shall be the peace of your what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 54:13 (ESV): "and great shall be the peace of your children."

questions.question: In righteousness you shall be established; you shall be far from oppression, for you shall not fear; and from terror, for it shall not come what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 54:14 (ESV): "for it shall not come near you."

questions.question: Behold, I have created the smith who blows the fire of coals and produces a weapon for its purpose. I have also created the ravager to do what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 54:16 (ESV): "I have also created the ravager to destroy."

questions.question: No weapon that is fashioned against you shall succeed, and you shall confute every tongue that rises against you in what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 54:17 (ESV): "every tongue that rises against you in judgment."

questions.question: For the LORD has called you like a wife deserted and grieved in spirit, like a wife of youth when she is what?
For a brief moment I deserted you, but with great compassion I will do what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 54:7 (ESV): "but with great compassion I will gather you."

questions.question: In overflowing anger for a moment I hid my face from you, but with everlasting love I will have compassion on you, says the LORD, your what?
This is like the days of whom to me? As I swore that the waters of whom should no more go over the earth...
questions.explanation: Isaiah 54:9 (ESV): "This is like the days of Noah to me:"

questions.question: I will make your pinnacles of agate, your gates of carbuncles, and all your wall of what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 54:12 (ESV): "and all your wall of precious stones."

key_verse_text: No weapon that is fashioned against you shall succeed, and you shall confute every tongue that rises against you in judgment. This is the heritage of the servants of the LORD and their vindication from me, declares the LORD.
